title: ACOT ( -1 ) is 3pi/4: the arccotangent is between 0 and pi

source.quote: Returns the principal value of the arccotangent, or inverse cotangent, of a number.
source.supports: the function; its example table has the row -2¼π, where COT is -1.00 and ACOT is 2.36

derivation: dax.guide's example evaluates ACOT ( COT ( x ) ) for x = -9π/4 + 0.001: COT is -1.00 and ACOT is shown as 2.36, so the arccotangent of -1 is 3π/4 (2.356194490192345), the range 0 to π, not -π/4.
